From Ikeja Underbridge 
Head southwest toward Obafemi Awolowo Way 
Exit the roundabout onto Obafemi Awolowo Way
Turn left onto Dr Nurudeen Olowopopo Way
Turn right onto Abba Sagoe Rd 
At the roundabout, take the 2nd exit onto Somide Odujinrin Ave
Make a U-turn at Rev. Emmanuel Adubifa St

items.information:
Shared route
From Jibowu Bus Stop to Igbobi College Yaba, Lagos, Nigeria. via Ikorodu-Ososun Rd and Bajulaye Rd/Morocco Rd.

6 min (1.9 km)
6 min in current traffic


1. Head south on Ikorodu-Ososun Rd toward Murtala Muhammed Way/Murtala Muhammed Bridge
2. Make a U-turn at Edmund Cres/Empire Rd/Higer College Rd/Moshalashi Rd
3. Turn right onto Jibowu St
4. Turn left onto Alakija St
5. At the roundabout, take the 1st exit onto Bajulaye Rd/Igbobi College Rd/Morocco Rd
6. Turn left onto Igbobi College Access Rd
7. Arrive at location: Igbobi College Yaba, Lagos, Nigeria.
For the best route in current traffic visit https://maps.app.goo.gl/bYemqvHpDyxGPqWX8
